g.text: LM head is not tied to the embedding
27-layer vision encoder (401M) + projector (46M) feeds image tokens into the embedding sequence
KV cache: about 33 KB per token (vs 5.4 MB for plain multi-head attention)
token mixer: KDA or Gated DSA
96 heads x 128 dims short depthwise Conv1d on q, k and v separately beta: one per head decay gate is low-rank fixed 128 x 128 state per head; cache does not grow with context
routed experts work in a smaller latent: 7168 -> 3584 -> 7168 shared experts: combined width 6144, every token, full 7168 space router uses sigmoid gating activation: SiTU-GLU (gated)

indexer: query from the 1536 latent, key Linear 7168 -> 128 with norm, per-head weights Linear 7168 -> 32 indexer picks the top 2048 tokens; attention runs only on those 96 heads; query/key 192 = 128 + 64, value 128 kv: 576 = 512 latent + 64 key dims; the 64 key dims skip the latent norm position encoding: NoPE (config mla_use_nope = true) cache per token: 576 MLA values + 128 indexer key values per layer
